title: Frozen AF-23 benchmark against inexpensive goal-aware Horn control policies

frozen_evaluation.source: AF23 Track B branching_gym cases_for, physical rule incidence, and root/episode budget
frozen_evaluation.weights: All existing AF23 original neural result counts are imported from exact signed source-run aggregate. Zero model training or neural score changes.
frozen_evaluation.requirement: Original parent project source unchanged. Any correction requires dated protocol amendment, never change this file.

controls.ancestor_greedy: Compute goal ancestor atoms by reverse propagation across all public Horn premises, then choose legal rule minimizing shortest relaxed hop count from produced head to goal, tie by physical slot; STOP only when no enabled rules or goal already reached.
controls.ancestor_random_5: Choose uniformly among enabled goal-ancestor-rule heads using five source-registered independent PRNG streams; else fallback to first legal; STOP only when no enabled rule or goal achieved.
controls.bfs_cap4: At each visited state, expand at most 4 unique host states with breadth-first forward search. If goal found, follow first-edge shortest witnessed path. If entire discovered search is exhausted without goal, STOP. On cap exhaustion, fall back to ancestor_greedy.
controls.bfs_cap64: Same controller with 64 host-state expansions/action; larger compute diagnostic, not compute-matched headline.
controls.closure_direct: Compute forward least-fixed-point reachability with public physical rules. If goal reachable, use backward required-subgoal provenance to choose a relevant legal action; if goal unreachable, STOP. Charge every examined rule and every closure pass.
controls.fixed: Existing first legal, no early STOP while enabled.
controls.shortest: AF23 exact shortest proof oracle, upper-bound only

run_rules.no_oracle: Do not call AF23 shortest_steps, optimal_actions, independent_bfs, any stored truth labels, or holdout scores inside symbolic controller inference. Oracle may only score/verify episodes externally.
run_rules.bounded_bfs: May search legal public graph for a goal within budget; actual visited nodes, generated edges, and rules examined counted. BFS itself computes a solution when found and should be presented as explicit symbolic planning, never as a neural inference comparator at equal FLOPs.
run_rules.stop: If forward search proves goal impossible (exhausted reachable state graph), STOP allowed; otherwise choose a legal rule. If no legal rule, STOP.
run_rules.tie: Lowest physical rule slot for equal-cost deterministic choices.
run_rules.count: Record actual host state expansions, legal rule examinations, ancestor propagation work and wall-clock in same pinned Python 3.12 CI runtime. Report medians, worst cases and all seed-depth paired differences; do not claim neural same-runtime latency from old archived results.
run_rules.random: PRNG keyed by seed, case_id and arm index; five independent streams registered before results
run_rules.provenance: Archive frozen exact source commitment, protocol SHA, graph hash, exact original AF23 aggregate digest, per-case rows for all symbols, reproducible scripts, tests and CI logs
run_rules.verdict: A graph-aware symbolic control matches neural if its success is within 5 percentage points of Direct at held-depth4 and VI2 at held-depth5, on at least 6 of 8 seeds. If match occurs, neural-search advantage over public structure is unsupported; otherwise result remains limited to listed symbolic controls.
run_rules.threshold_note: The 5-point match criterion is a comparison gate, not a registered claim of neural supremacy. Inference compute must be disclosed; comparisons lacking matched wall-time are labeled algorithmic.

stage2_adversarial.goal: Prospective nonisomorphic rule grammars with truly misleading goal-ancestor branches and varying minimal proof costs
stage2_adversarial.will_require: Separate source-pinned matched-neural-checkpoint test with all controls and independent oracle. No retrospectively selected adversarial cases.
